::: {#rem-cross-entropy-expected-surprisal}
#### Cross-entropy is an expected surprisal

By @thm-cross-entropy-expectation, the [cross-entropy](#def-cross-entropy) $H(p, q)$ is the average [surprisal](#def-surprisal) of [outcomes](probability-basics.qmd#def-experiment-outcome) drawn from $p$,
with each surprisal measured by $q$ as $-\log q_k$.
By @cor-cross-entropy-entropy, measuring with $p$ itself gives the [entropy](#def-entropy).

:::
